hero.description: BudStock is a platform where extra materials find new owners. Save time and money by buying cheaper, or free up your space.

1.title: Take a photo
1.desc: Photograph the leftover materials in good lighting.

2.title: Add description
2.desc: Specify characteristics, quantity, and a fair price.

3.title: Set location
3.desc: Buyers will find you on the map right in their neighborhood.

4.title: Sell and earn
4.desc: Clear your space and get funds for new ideas.

1.title: Search on the map
1.desc: Find the materials you need right in your area.

2.title: Save money
2.desc: Buy quality items significantly cheaper than in stores.

3.title: Chat to agree
3.desc: Discuss details and meeting time with the seller.

4.title: Choose the best
4.desc: Compare prices and item conditions among listings.

smartAlert.title: Smart Alert
